Reference / regex/split

regex/split#

RegexParts is the collection itself.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let fields = RegexParts(origin: "one, two;three", regex: Regex("[,;]\\s*"));
for fields -> field {
    Stdout().writeln(field);
}

Description#

RegexParts is the collection itself. It does not wrap an array behind values(), and it does not materialize the complete split before traversal.

An explicit limit counts separators, so a limit of 1 yields at most two fields. Empty leading, adjacent and trailing fields are retained.

Public API#
